description: We chose this challenge because, as missions head to Mars with 20-minute comms delays and no doctors on board, astronauts need software that can save lives on its own and help remote communities on Earth. Our team is building smart, Earth-independent medical software that compares real-time vitals against personal space baselines, adapts to spacecraft or lunar bases, and guides crews through emergencies. Join us if you love coding, biology, UI design, or pitching!
